title: Spatial disparities in simulated patrol detection: a reproducible generative-model audit across Baltimore and Chicago
abstract: arXiv:2603.18987v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Auditing predictive policing requires distinguishing recorded crime incidents, simulated patrol observations, and the demographic characteristics of places. We present a reproducible spatial simulation audit combining a generative adversarial network (GAN) for patrol allocation with a probabilistic detection model. Using frozen archives of 145,178 Baltimore records (2017-2019) and 234,882 Chicago records (2022), we rebuild geographic covariates from Census tract boundaries and American Community Survey data. We compare GAN allocation with empirical-location sampling and uniform-area deployment under alternative observation streams. Twenty random seeds per condition yield 560 trajectories, each covering February through December. Under detection-only training, mean detection-rate differences between Black-majority and White-majority areas range from -2.03 to 0.75 percentage points across city-years, while total coverage ranges from 1.

translated_title: 模拟巡逻检测中的空间差异：横跨巴尔的摩与芝加哥的可复现生成模型审计
translated_abstract: 审计预测性警务需要区分记录在案的犯罪事件、模拟巡逻观测以及地区的人口统计特征。我们提出了一种可复现的空间模拟审计方法，将用于巡逻分配的生成对抗网络（GAN）与概率检测模型相结合。利用145,178条巴尔的摩记录（2017-2019年）和234,882条芝加哥记录（2022年）的冻结存档数据，我们基于人口普查区边界和美国社区调查数据重建了地理协变量。我们在不同观测流条件下，将GAN分配方案与经验位置抽样以及均匀区域部署进行了比较。每种条件下二十个随机种子共产生560条模拟轨迹，每条轨迹覆盖二月至十二月。在仅检测训练条件下，黑人多数区与白人多数区之间的平均检测率差异在各城市-年份中介于-2.03至0.75个百分点之间，而总覆盖率范围为1.（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合生成对抗网络巡逻分配与概率检测模型的可复现空间模拟审计框架，利用巴尔的摩和芝加哥的犯罪记录数据量化了模拟巡逻部署在黑人多数区与白人多数区之间的检测率差异。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reproducible spatial simulation audit combining GAN-based patrol allocation with a probabilistic detection model, quantifying detection-rate disparities between Black-majority and White-majority areas using frozen crime record archives from Baltimore and Chicago.
